title: SlimModel ingest and pin safeguard for low-precision releases
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add an ingest and validation flow for compressed model artifacts (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) that produces a signed model artifact, a pinned serving manifest, and a published performance profile. The flow must include CI gates, lightweight canary sampling, and automated rollback triggers when perf regressions or quality degradation are detected.
background: We support multiple low-precision formats but onboarding is ad-hoc: different teams upload artifacts with inconsistent metadata, testing is manual, and version pinning happens after the fact. This increases risk of silent regressions when runtime switches to lower-precision variants for cost reasons. Prior tickets addressed profiling and canary infrastructure, but we lack a single ingest+pin+publish flow that combines artifact signing, perf profiling, SLO-aware canary, and rollback automation.
goals: Standardize artifact intake metadata for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ (schema + signer).
Create CI gate that runs a perf/quality smoke suite and rejects artifacts failing thresholds.
Publish a machine-readable performance profile that the routing engine can consume for pinning and fallback decisions.
Implement a light-weight staged canary with rollback automation tied to the performance profile metrics.
success_metrics: <1% percent of onboarding artifacts deployed to prod without passing CI gate
Detect >90% of perf regressions within first 10k requests in canary traffic
Average rollout time from ingestion to pinned publish < 4 hours
Reduction in human rollback interventions for low-precision releases by 80%
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Comprehensive evals are expensive; initial smoke suite must balance cost vs signal quality.
Signing artifacts adds complexity to developer flow; we will provide tooling to auto-generate signatures in CI.
Tight thresholds reduce risk but increase false-positives; we will make thresholds tunable per-model family.
implementation_steps: Define artifact intake schema (manifest fields: model_hash, quant_format, calibration_seed, perf_profile_version, family_id, compatible_kernels).
Add signing step to artifact build CI (RFC + libraries + examples in sdk/cli).
Build a smoke-suite runner in the onboarding service that executes latency/throughput/answer-quality checks on a small synthetic dataset.
Emit a signed performance profile JSON and store it in the model registry with immutable versioning.
Expose API to pin a model version for serving and to annotate pin reason (auto-canary | manual | rollback).
Wire canary orchestration: allocate small % of traffic, collect telemetry, evaluate canary policies, and auto-roll back on breach.
Add CI gating integration to block promotion when smoke-suite fails and create automatic issues with logs and sample traces.
test_plan: Unit tests for schema validation and signature verification.
E2E CI job that simulates ingest->smoke->publish with synthetic artifacts (INT8, GPTQ, AWQ).
Canary dry-run in staging with real traffic mirroring and inject synthetic regressions to validate rollback triggers.
Chaos scenario: transient perf degradation (GPU contention) to ensure system differentiates noise vs genuine regressions.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): enable ingest flow for internal teams only; require manual approval to publish pins.
Phase 2 (limited prod): auto-publish performance profiles, but pin must be manually approved for production serving.
Phase 3 (full prod): enable automatic pin publication and canarying with auto-rollback for low-variance model families.
Post-launch: run weekly review of canary outcomes and adjust smoke-suite thresholds.
telemetry_signals: per-token latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) with quantile deltas vs baseline
throughput drop relative to pinned baseline
per-prompt answer-quality score distributions (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim similarity on evalset)
error rates (model runtime exceptions, OOM, invalid output sanitization failures)
resource anomaly signals (GPU memory, host CPU, kernel-fallback counts)
comments: 2026-02-16 - Aisha Patel: Initial stub created. Design doc uploaded to Confluence. Listed scope for runtime and registry changes.

2026-02-22 - Diego Morales: Spike completed for artifact signing library. PR with signer prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3492. Observed 2s overhead for signature verification in ingest path; acceptable but we should cache verifications for repeated reads.
2026-02-27 - PM review (Lena Qureshi): Requested addition of a customer-impact tag and a default safety threshold for answer-quality to reduce noisy rollbacks.
2026-03-03 - Eng sync: Decided smoke-suite will use a curated 200-sample evalset covering core intents; team agreed to make it pluggable per-model family.
2026-03-06 - Design feedback (Tom Brooks): UX for pin publishing should show diff vs current pinned profile and expected cost delta. Adding a step to console rollout UI issues.

2026-03-10 - Diego Morales: Canary harness in staging passed synthetic regression injection tests. Implemented telemetry contract and dashboard widgets. Open follow-ups: add GPU kernel fallback count to metrics and tune thresholds.
2026-03-12 - Security (Ivy Chen): Quick review completed; recommend adding KMS signing option for enterprise customers. Will file follow-up ticket for KMS integration.
